nodes.name: AdminDashboard.css
nodes.summary: Comprehensive styling for the admin dashboard interface including sidebar navigation, stats cards, location and user tables, search bar, and responsive layout adaptations.
nodes.languageNotes: BEM naming convention with CSS custom properties for theming; uses CSS Grid and Flexbox for responsive layouts; includes media queries for tablet breakpoint.

nodes.name: BlogPageStyles.css
nodes.summary: Styling for blog listing, blog detail, and create blog pages featuring card-based grid layouts, hero sections with parallax-style overlays, and form styling.
nodes.languageNotes: Implements featured background gradients and decorative grid patterns; uses CSS Grid for responsive card layouts; includes detail page hero overlay effects.

nodes.name: CreateAccountStyles.css
nodes.summary: Authentication styling for the account creation page with a full-viewport background image, centered form card, and form input styling with focus states.
nodes.languageNotes: Uses background image with gradient overlay for atmospheric effect; form inputs include focus ring styling using box-shadow.

nodes.name: LoginStyles.css
nodes.summary: Authentication styling for the login page with similar visual treatment to account creation, including form inputs, error states, and secondary action buttons.
nodes.languageNotes: Shares visual language with CreateAccountStyles; includes secondary button variant and notice/error message styling.

nodes.name: PlacesStyles.css
nodes.summary: Extensive styling for the places/locations browsing page featuring a search interface with autocomplete dropdown, filter controls, and responsive mountain location cards.
nodes.languageNotes: Implements search bar with absolute-positioned dropdown results; includes filter form styling; mountain cards feature hover effects with image scaling.

nodes.name: ProfileStyles.css
nodes.summary: User profile page styling with sidebar layout, avatar management section, editable profile details form, and toast notification component.
nodes.languageNotes: Two-column layout with sidebar; avatar section with overlay upload trigger; includes upload progress bar styling.

nodes.name: WeatherWindowStyles.css
nodes.summary: Weather forecast page styling with a search form for filtering by date and conditions, and results display featuring location cards with temperature rankings.
nodes.languageNotes: Four-column search form grid; weather result cards with prominent temperature display; includes responsive adjustments for mobile layouts.

nodes.name: NotificationModal.css
nodes.summary: Modal dialog styling for displaying notification and FAQ content with overlay backdrop, slide-in animation, and action buttons for reply and archive.
nodes.languageNotes: Includes fadeIn keyframe animation; modal transitions with translateY for smooth entrance; responsive stacking on mobile.

nodes.name: NotificationPopover.css
nodes.summary: Popover styling for notification dropdown with badge indicator, scrollable notification list, read/unread states, and mark-all-read functionality.
nodes.languageNotes: Custom scrollbar styling for webkit browsers; includes unread/read state visual differentiation with background colors.

nodes.name: PageNotFoundStyles.css
nodes.summary: 404 error page styling with full-viewport background, large display typography for the error code, and centered call-to-action button.
nodes.languageNotes: Minimal styling with dramatic background image and gradient overlay; uses clamp() for responsive heading size.

nodes.name: ProfileDropdown.css
nodes.summary: User profile dropdown menu styling with avatar button, animated dropdown menu, and navigation items with hover effects.
nodes.languageNotes: Includes fadeIn animation with scale transform for dropdown entrance; uses simpler white/gray color scheme.

nodes.name: ProfileDropdownStyles.css
nodes.summary: Alternative profile dropdown styling with forest theme colors matching the application design system, including header button and menu item styling.
nodes.languageNotes: Uses application color tokens (var(--color-forest), var(--color-rust)); same class names as ProfileDropdown.css with different styling.

nodes.name: ReviewFormStyles.css
nodes.summary: Inline review form styling with textarea input, star rating selector with hover states, and submit button with disabled state handling.
nodes.languageNotes: Star rating uses CSS-driven hover/active states; includes focus and error message styling.

nodes.name: ReviewListStyles.css
nodes.summary: Review list and individual review item styling with avatar section, star rating display, date formatting, and hover effects on review cards.
nodes.languageNotes: Two-column layout (avatar + content) transforms to single column on mobile; includes star rating display using gold color.

nodes.name: TripStyles.css
nodes.summary: Trip planning section styling with dark forest theme background, three-column card grid, and hover effects on trip location cards.
nodes.languageNotes: Uses forest green background with warm cream text colors; trip cards feature image zoom on hover with border color change.
